title: Activities | Rescheduling a call with "log a missed call" fails: "One or more fields in the payload are read-only."

panels.caption: TAVI — scheduled call "QA ACT EV A-B1" (start 26/10 15:20): Reschedule to 27/10 10:00 with "The call went unanswered — log a missed call" ticked, then Reschedule. The call keeps 15:20 and no missed call appears.

Zoho — Calls › Add Call (live, opened and cancelled): call statuses and Start Time / Duration. Our Zoho org has no calls, so rescheduling was not tried live; the behaviour comes from the Calls help article.
TAVI — the request the dialog sends and the server answer (captured in the browser).

rows: Reschedule an unanswered call and log the missed attempt
Help docs (Calls article): if a scheduled call is unanswered you can reschedule it; a missed-call activity is logged and the call moves to the new time. Not tried live: our Zoho org has no calls.
The dialog offers exactly this option ("A missed-call entry is kept for this attempt; the call itself moves to the new time").

The dialog sends a missed-call record that includes read-only fields (approval_status, created_at); the server refuses it with 422 FIELD_PERMISSION_DENIED "One or more fields in the payload are read-only." (shown as an error toast).
Unchanged (26/10/2026 15:20) and no missed call logged. The same dialog without the tick moves the call.
